reply.summary: Iuriso is a gaunt winged harbinger who was once a gentle healer on a dying red world. Broken by grief, she now serves a tyrant of fire and soars with her sisters to extinguish every living thing on a doomed planet.

feats.scene: Iuriso rakes a skyline with a sweeping wave of withering force that lays a district bare.
Iuriso keeps flying after a crushing impact into a collapsing tower.

reply.summary: Numamcol is a courteous skeletal collector who escorts the dying to their rest with a long curved blade. A trickster once trapped him in a sack, and he took it with good humour and now asks for the occasional holiday there.

feats.scene: Numamcol sweeps his blade across a sickbed and gently severs a soul from its body.
Numamcol sits unharmed inside a sack that swallows ordinary matter.

reply.summary: Ilamrau is a pale, black-haired elder sibling in an eternal family, a cheerful guide who sees each life through to its end. She has existed since just before the first living things and will remain until the last one is gone.

feats.scene: Ilamrau ends the charter of a corrupt town, and its streets crumble away.
Ilamrau walks unscathed through a battlefield of collapsing monuments.

reply.summary: Tanneotan is a calm brown-haired woman who appears at the threshold of a soul's last hour and performs her role with a brisk sort of kindness. She plays music while she works and speaks as if reading from a duty roster.

feats.scene: Tanneotan plucks a few notes that settle a restless spirit.
Tanneotan strolls through a crowded corridor unbothered by a stumbling orderly.

reply.summary: Lesnto is a grey-skinned crone who throws infernal flame and rides an enormous winged beast. Betrayed by relatives, she turned bitter and now lends her fire to a team of ruthless enforcers.

feats.scene: Lesnto engulfs a rooftop in a gout of flame that melts the surrounding antenna.
Lesnto is flung from her mount and rolls to her feet.

reply.summary: Leoeona is a shadowy figure with a toadstool-themed alias who lurks in the margins of a rainy island's streets. Little is certain about this sly operator beyond a taste for secrecy.

feats.scene: Leoeona shoves a courier into a doorway to snatch a satchel.
Leoeona rolls out of a rain-slick fall and disappears into an alley.

reply.summary: Aucisres is a red-haired hired killer who fights with a deck of lethal cards, some sharp, some incendiary. He traps a target in a locked room and sets it alight before a rival's lover puts him in the ground.

feats.scene: Aucisres flings a burning card that engulfs a sealed apartment in flame.
Aucisres takes a punch from a bowman and keeps dealing.

reply.summary: Stisau is a bald spy of an old totalitarian bloc who bends minds with a ray from his eyes. Anyone he commands obeys at once, until a reflective surface turns his own order against him.

feats.scene: Stisau orders a pilot to jump from his cockpit, and the man complies.
Stisau survives a scuffle on a rocky airfield.

reply.summary: Teniu is a grim card-themed thug working for a fortune-obsessed schemer, appearing in a single dramatic raid. Carrying a sinister symbolic motif, he lunges at heroes with fatalistic menace.

feats.scene: Teniu hurls a glowing card that blasts a lamp from its post.
Teniu endures a tackle from a costumed rival and snarls.

reply.summary: Roseontel is a feral colossus from a vanished star-nest, a ravenous twin that craves the extinction of worlds. Even its old trainer feared to loose it, but a mercenary eventually seizes command.

feats.scene: Roseontel devours a world whole, crushing it under tentacles the size of mountain ranges.
Roseontel absorbs a barrage of divine weapons across the open sea and keeps feeding.

reply.summary: Llirnsor is a rarely-seen underworld teacher, known only by a title that hints at his refusal to stay down. He trains an apprentice in criminal craft from the shadows of an eastern capital.

feats.scene: Llirnsor lands a clean palm strike on a student during a lesson.
Llirnsor shrugs off a hard fall during a street chase.

reply.summary: Tauntsti is an eastern syndicate boss who began by faking his demise in a yogic trance. Eventually his skull stripped of flesh, he gained a body that regenerates and cannot be put away.

feats.scene: Tauntsti leads his retainers in a brutal ambush that nearly overwhelms a masked hero.
Tauntsti is struck by lightning and walks it off after a brief collapse.

reply.summary: Tinolirn is a deranged crime lord who absorbed the properties of a restorative pool, becoming a mad, unkillable boss whose blood is farmed by a cult of assassins. He mocks the young hero who hunts him with grotesque self-styled titles.

feats.scene: Tinolirn bombs a crowded bus with a casual flick of a detonator.
Tinolirn is sealed in a safe and launched into orbit, then wakes and persists.

reply.summary: Arneoti is a one-time antagonist in a grim mask who menaced a beetle-armoured champion in a single outing. Nothing else is known about the masked figure.

feats.scene: Arneoti swings a club at a masked rival.
Arneoti stands his ground against a charging armoured opponent.

reply.summary: Eonuiu is a long-term patient with a dramatic costume who swears an alien world abducted him and its army is about to invade. He tracks a fugitive mercenary to deliver his warning, and gets the spelling of his own title very specific.

feats.scene: Eonuiu slashes a knife at an intruder's coat.
Eonuiu emerges from a transport beam unharmed.

reply.summary: Stites is a former patriotic heroine whose government mission ended in surgeries and plastic grafts. Turned to savage vengeance, she hunts an armoured rival from her hometown and is undone by her own hired muscle.

feats.scene: Stites tears the door off a vault with her reinforced fists.
Stites takes a heavy blast from a rival's weapon and stays standing.

reply.summary: Vauva is a menacing figure in a grim visage who stalked a nocturnal city's rooftops, recalled for only a single memorable appearance. The villain hides behind the mask more than behind any particular scheme.

feats.scene: Vauva hurls a brick through a shop window.
Vauva drops from a fire escape and runs away.

reply.summary: Estorta is a skull-faced cyborg teen at a school for troubled youth who inherited a flamboyant family trade. His enhanced frame lets him brawl above his age while he sorts out his place between class and crime.

feats.scene: Estorta punches a locker through its hinges in a hallway scuffle.
Estorta absorbs a blow from a larger rival with a clatter of metal.

reply.summary: Eonle is a white-haired angel who left the celestial host for a gaudy desert casino. He runs the tables with a feathered shrug and an eye for deals struck between worlds.

feats.scene: Eonle wallops a card cheat with a single backhanded blow.
Eonle strolls out of a ruined lounge after a firefight, undamaged.

reply.summary: Nelsan is a green-eyed, red-haired woman bitten by a bloodthirsty fiend but kept half-human by her kind heart. She enjoys much of a vampire's strength and speed, though less than a pure one, and stands by a weary immortal friend.

feats.scene: Nelsan hurls a would-be attacker across a farmhouse kitchen.
Nelsan walks away from a collapsing barn with only quickly-closing cuts.
Nelsan sprints across a field in a streak.

reply.summary: Arval is a green-eyed time-displaced manipulator who bends ambient warmth, chilling objects or heating them to a blaze, and floats on a cloud of heated vapour. She serves a hired villain team and later a larger league of rogues.

feats.scene: Arval concentrates ambient warmth into a searing blast that melts a pier.
Arval absorbs a fall into a harbour and floats back up.

reply.summary: Iaseollu is a blond young woman in a rural old-world village, betrothed to a man who does not outlive the story. Her brief tale ends with her short life and a descendant who echoes her name.

feats.scene: Iaseollu hurls a pail of water at a drunk intruder.
Iaseollu shrugs off a hard tumble down a muddy hill.

reply.summary: Nental is a brown-haired brawler who wins fights with her fists and eye beams, and quips about shopping cash while doing it. Strong and tough enough to face a glowing warrior, she throws explosive bursts from her own body.

feats.scene: Nental sends a burst from her eyes that gouges a crater in a shopping avenue.
Nental stands unhurt through a volley of searing blasts.

reply.summary: Rnicorrn is a black-eyed alien noble who possesses hosts and stands beside her consort in a campaign against a team of reformers. She fights in borrowed bodies, then flees when the odds sour.

feats.scene: Rnicorrn commandeers a host's body and tears through a police station wall.
Rnicorrn is ejected from a host and shakes off the backlash.

reply.summary: Tiasalen is a black-eyed assassin who opens his own veins to work blood sorcery. He steers enemy limbs like puppets, opens doorways across great distance and senses distant enchantments.

feats.scene: Tiasalen forces an opponent's arm to snap their own weapon in two.
Tiasalen slips through a portal just before a heavy strike lands.

reply.summary: Orrniti is a black-eyed criminal with the bounding agility of an insect, hopping across rooftops of a mammoth city. He is repeatedly jailed by a stretchy hero and put away along with other crooks.

feats.scene: Orrniti launches himself feet-first into a security guard.
Orrniti lands a leap from a billboard and springs up again.

reply.summary: Nasilsu is a bald, black-eyed stand-in for a legendary mountain leader who commands a secretive order devoted to letting corrupt cities fall. He fights a young billionaire in a burning temple and is felled by timber.

feats.scene: Nasilsu parries a sword strike and lands a flurry of blows.
Nasilsu is buried under a collapsing beam during a duel.

reply.summary: Ceoeor is a cosmic shadow cast at the first moment of creation, devoted to unmaking everything that exists. Worshipped by a secretive cult and impossible to defeat, it was merely slowed to a crawl by a clever trick.

feats.scene: Ceoeor erases a stretch of reality, leaving no trace of what stood there.
Ceoeor advances unharmed through every weapon thrown by its pursuers.

reply.summary: Ntstiria is a retired continental champion who bends soil and stone to his will, and later takes a quiet government desk job. His old crusade comes back to claim him in a grisly end.

feats.scene: Ntstiria heaves a ridge of bedrock upward to block an advancing militia convoy.
Ntstiria stands in a collapsing quarry and walks out of the dust.

reply.summary: Nastton is a blond, cartoon-styled child, one of a pair of twins who officiates a go-kart contest at a miniature city's racetrack. She is cute, small and harmless.

feats.scene: Nastton waves a chequered flag to start a go-kart race.
Nastton tumbles onto a grassy verge and giggles.

reply.summary: Sartor is a golden-haired, white-eyed goddess of growth and soil who sits among lords of cosmic balance. She shifts shape, turns foes to stone and steps across dimensions, and her name is shouted as a curse by mortals.

feats.scene: Sartor turns an invading company to stone with a wave of her hand.
Sartor remains unmoved while a mountain collapses upon her sanctum.

reply.summary: Nanstiso is a red-haired federal investigator with blue eyes, a methodical detective who follows leads across the country. She is entirely mundane and relies on training and a sidearm.

feats.scene: Nanstiso fires a pistol shot that clips a fleeing suspect's tyre.
Nanstiso takes a bruising fall in a chase and keeps running.

reply.summary: Stinusan is an orange-skinned apprentice who earned a will-powered ring and helped a princess topple her tyrant father. He married the princess and was knighted for his service.

feats.scene: Stinusan sculpts a glowing battering ram that smashes the palace gates.
Stinusan holds a shining shield against a barrage from the royal guard.

reply.summary: Minumrus is a bald crook in a propeller beanie who runs a gang with his cousins, stealing jewels while his relative lifts furs. He is repeatedly collared by a caped pair and tries again with a bank job.

feats.scene: Minumrus smashes a jewellery case with a swing of his club.
Minumrus takes a heavy punch from a masked hero and stays upright.

reply.summary: Corneo is a bald club owner who took a criminal alias from a children's rhyme with his cousin, and was left with a ruined face after a brutal kick from a caped enforcer. He later helps a hat-obsessed schemer lure victims to a stage.

feats.scene: Corneo swings a bar stool at a rowdy patron.
Corneo endures a kick to the face that needs hours of surgery.

reply.summary: Toriureo is a hired lackey who can hop from one place to another in a blink, serving a white-furred mob boss. He is a minor annoyance for a hammer-wielding hero.

feats.scene: Toriureo vanishes and reappears behind a guard to snatch a briefcase.
Toriureo takes a clubbing and teleports clear.

reply.summary: Rivau is a yellow-eyed alien conqueror who works as a recruiter for his warlord, boosted by blue flame from a frozen moon and a human gene. His enemies at home imprisoned him, and his immortal agents grew careless on a distant world.

feats.scene: Rivau leads a raid that razes a fortress-city beneath a rain of blue flame.
Rivau stands unscathed in the centre of a collapsing citadel.

reply.summary: Rnivarlu is an orange-eyed engineered living weapon, specialised in flattening terrain, who clashes with a young heroine in a crowded city. Her strength matches that of her foe, but poison from a teammate's tentacles forces her to retreat.

feats.scene: Rnivarlu pounds the ground and levels a swath of the metropolis.
Rnivarlu weathers a flurry of heavy blows without a bruise.

reply.summary: Rireva is a hairless, monstrous-looking deity of dread, one of a pair of twin brothers born to a war-lord and a love-goddess. He sows panic through illusions, reads minds and turns into a bolt of lightning.

feats.scene: Rireva transforms into lightning and hurtles through a temple wall.
Rireva withstands the blast of a mortal heroine's strike without flinching.

reply.summary: Lanlan is a red-eyed deity of fear whose hair is a nest of venomous snakes. Together with his twin brother, he serves a war-lord in an underworld campaign against mortal women.

feats.scene: Lanlan sinks serpent fangs into a warrior's shield and the metal sizzles.
Lanlan walks off a collision with a collapsing hall of stone.

reply.summary: Caiueo is a scatterbrained, ever-changing younger sibling in an eternal family, whose speech wanders and whose appearance shifts with her mood. She is cherished and protected by her elder relatives.

feats.scene: Caiueo giggles and the laws of a district tangle into nonsense.
Caiueo wanders unharmed through a collapsing realm.

reply.summary: Onevalli is a bald, grey-haired national leader in a far-future setting who is literally under siege, fighting from his office with a sidearm. He is a satire of a political figure of the era that created him.

feats.scene: Onevalli fires a pistol at attackers from behind his desk.
Onevalli ducks under a desk as a window explodes.

reply.summary: Mistisi is a red-haired, black-eyed woman who grips her victims and forces them to relive their worst regrets until they break. A strong-willed foe can shake her hold, and the resulting backlash knocks her unconscious.

feats.scene: Mistisi seizes a guard's wrist and floods his mind with terrors.
Mistisi collapses from a mental backlash and wakes unharmed.

reply.summary: Terreoma is a white-haired girl abducted and bathed in dark sorcery that gave her gills, a glow and tough skin, so she can only breathe underwater. After her rescue she settles into a sunken city to learn her new body.

feats.scene: Terreoma bursts a flash of radiance that blinds a pair of guards.
Terreoma shrugs off a hard blow in the lab of her captor.

reply.summary: Iaesieo is a blue-eyed warrior woman who left her island home and shows quiet bravery in a long voyage. She carries the generic strength and discipline of her sisterhood.

feats.scene: Iaesieo cleaves a boulder with a spear thrust.
Iaesieo withstands a crushing fall from a sea cliff.

reply.summary: Amoleeru is a dark-haired schemer whose trade is false faces and costumes, working for an evil council against a young band of do-gooders. He relies on cunning rather than force.

feats.scene: Amoleeru springs a trap disguised as a delivery crate.
Amoleeru is knocked flat and slips away in a new costume.

reply.summary: Nenirnlan is a red-eyed shapeshifting fiend summoned from a mystical realm by a gangster, who then kills him and takes over his organisation. She feeds on the anguish of others and fights her sister in a decisive duel.

feats.scene: Nenirnlan rips through a reinforced warehouse wall with her talons.
Nenirnlan shrugs off a hail of gunfire from an entire crew.
Nenirnlan streaks over a rooftop skyline.

reply.summary: Numor is a hidden clan chief who commands a band of killers and has a son to carry on his work. He travels constantly and dies in a pitched fight with a young vigilante.

feats.scene: Numor drives a blade into a rival's armour during a skirmish.
Numor stays upright after a hard blow in the clan's camp.

reply.summary: Tiutir is a blond member of a ruthless clique who throws concussive blasts of energy and dates a fellow member. He dies in a short run against a star-themed hero.

feats.scene: Tiutir hurls a concussive blast that collapses a storefront.
Tiutir is flung through a window and gets up shaken.

reply.summary: Ronvautiu is a former physician who lost his licence after a spree against criminals and now sells his skills as a bodyguard and assassin in a special suit. He is acrobatic, a skilled thrower and a trained martial artist, nursing a deep grudge.

feats.scene: Ronvautiu launches a flurry of throwing blades at a rival's guard.
Ronvautiu takes a heavy armoured blow and rolls clear.
